register: # SOURCE: SMA Technical Information SUNSPEC MODBUS (SunSpecModbus-TI-en-11) for Sunny Boy, Sunny Tripower and Sunny Highpower. Supported 100-series models: 1, 11, 12, 101-103, 120, 121, 122, 123, 160. SMA plans to add the 700-series models (701, 702, 704, 714 and others) to profile 2.0 in a future firmware version; they are not mapped here.

# CONNECTION: Modbus TCP only. SMA's Modbus interface is off by default; activate it with the installation assistant, which also sets the TCP port (502 is the standard Modbus port). The SunSpec unit ID is the SMA Modbus unit ID + 123, so 126 with the preset value.

# NOT VERIFIED: the default anchors assume the model order 1, 11, 12, 103, 120, 121, 122, 123, 160 worked out from the standard model lengths (the first 100-series inverter model then starts at 40185, which is not confirmed). The rows themselves use the standard SunSpec layouts. Neither has been checked against an SMA inverter; discovery corrects the addresses on a real device. Models not supported by a given product are left out of its chain.

# DYNAMIC MAP: rows whose register column is [anchor+offset] are template rows. The anchors come from the SunSpec model chain the device reports (discovery in the protocol JSON) and fall back to the discovery_defaults in that JSON, so the map is complete before a device has been read. {i} repeats a row once per instance found (MPPT modules, meters). See documentation/architecture/dynamic_register_discovery.md.
